content:
Maya R.: Vendor sent revised payment flow for the H200 batch — they want 50% prepay OR escrow managed by forwarder. Shipping will be split EU / APAC and they now require RMA labels up-front. Any ops implications?

Ajit: Do we have the PO/invoice numbers? any lead time delta? @Sofia fyi.

Sofia: PO #45823 still open. Vendor says lead time moves to 2–3 weeks after payment confirmation. They also flagged a possible thermal hold on a small subset of SKUs — depot might hold on acceptance.

Liam C.: If we prepay they can shave ~1 week off ETAs. Escrow preserves contingency but finance needs extra approvals (slower). Heads-up: EU pool will drop ~8 H200 GPUs next week if we don't expedite — I updated the capacity spreadsheet.

Maya R.: Vendor excerpt (they pasted in the email):
```
"Payment options: 50% prepayment OR escrow via 3rd-party forwarder. RMA labels: vendor requires templates uploaded prior to dispatch confirmation; depot will only accept units with pre-registered RMA labels. ETA: 14–21 days post-payment. Thermal exceptions may require depot inspection"
```

Ajit: That RMA clause is new. Means manifest pipeline needs label param earlier in flow. Ops, can we generate vendor-specific label IDs ahead of pickup?

Sofia: Yes, we can. We'll reuse the existing label schema but need to add `vendor_label_id` to the manifest. Small PR — should be low risk.

VendorOpsBot: Ticket VENDOR-7123 created (vendor docs attached, PO 45823). ETA field set to vendor-reported window.

FinanceBot: Escrow setup will add ~3 business days for account approval. Holding fee estimate: ~$12k for the batch if placed in escrow vs prepaid discount of ~1.5%.

Maya R.: Proposal: escrow for EU leg (protects against customs/thermal rejections), prepay APAC to avoid hold. This hedges lead-time vs risk. Thoughts?

Liam C.: +1 to split approach. Ops impact checklist: reroute EU to AMS depot for faster inspection, update runbook to reflect 48h depot acceptance SLA once shipped. I'll capture runbook diffs.

Ajit: I'll loop in Legal for escrow terms, CC Finance. If legal signs off within 24h we can set escrow for EU.

Sofia: I'll open the PR to add `vendor_label_id` and mark it for rollback flag. Snippet for manifest change:
```json
{"manifest": {"items": [...], "vendor_label_id": "<string>"}}
```

Maya R.: Great. @VendorOpsBot please confirm vendor will accept our label template and send sample labels. We also need them to confirm depot acceptance workflow (photos / ASN). :thumbsup:

VendorOpsBot: Vendor acknowledged. They will send sample RMA labels and depot acceptance checklist within 6 hours and update ticket VENDOR-7123.

Maya R.: OK — I'll hold the EU escrow decision until Legal/Finance confirm but moving forward with label changes and EU reroute prep. Thanks everyone.
